title: Fix Wazuh Server Version Mismatch on Proxmox
description: Wazuh server on Proxmox has version mismatch between API (4.14.1) and Dashboard (4.11.2). Need to upgrade dashboard to match API version to resolve the error: 'API and dashboard version mismatch. API version: 4.14.1. App version: 4.11.2'
actions_required: SSH access to Wazuh server on Proxmox
